memories.content: Team standup moved to Tuesday and Thursday at 9:30am PST (Updated: superseded previous Monday schedule)
Database is PostgreSQL hosted on AWS RDS with read replicas
CI/CD pipeline uses GitHub Actions with self-hosted runners
User prefers Python over TypeScript for backend work
User strongly dislikes slow feedback loops in test suites
Project uses Antigravity agentic platform with Gemini 3.8
Deployment target is Kubernetes on EKS

Consolidated System Profile: Python-first microservices hosted on AWS EKS with PostgreSQL RDS (read-replicated), managed by Antigravity Gemini 3.8. Team observes Tue/Thu standup cadence and requires fast-feedback CI/CD via self-hosted GitHub Actions.
